_how_to_update: Upcoming industry events for the TV. Add an event only after checking its date and venue on the organiser's OWN website (not listing sites, which are often wrong). Fields: name, start (YYYY-MM-DD), end (optional), city, venue, topic (gcc / ta / tech / startup), about (one line), url, verified (where you checked and when). The TV starts showing an event 60 days before it begins, counts down ('in 12 days', 'Tomorrow', 'Today'), and hides it after it ends.
